panels.title: Public URLs

targets.expr: probe_success

panels.description: Blackbox probe from this host through the public path: DNS, TLS (validated), BunkerWeb and the backend. PublicUrlDown fires after 5 min.

panels.title: Certificate expires in

targets.expr: min by (instance) ((probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry - time()) / 86400)

panels.description: Shortest remaining validity over all probed sites. Let's Encrypt renews at 30 days; CertificateExpiresSoon fires below 14.

panels.title: Requests / min

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [1h])) / 60) or vector(0)

panels.description: Average over the last hour, both sites, without BunkerWeb's own health checks.

panels.title: Visitors (1h)

targets.expr: count(sum by (ip) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [1h]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Distinct client addresses in the last hour. Includes scanners.

panels.title: 5xx (1h)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | status =~ "5.." [1h])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Server errors answered to clients in the last hour. Zero is right; 502 means the backend pod was down.

panels.title: Bans (24h)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |= "[BADBEHAVIOR]" |= "is banned for" [24h])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Clients BunkerWeb banned for 24 h after too many 4xx in a minute (threshold in bunker_service_bad_behavior_threshold). See the log panel for the addresses.

panels.title: Errors (24h)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service="bunker", container=~"bunker-.*"} |~ "\\[(crit|alert|emerg)\\]|\\[ERROR\\]" [24h])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Error and critical lines from both containers. BunkerWebError alerts on each.

panels.title: Public URLs over time

targets.expr: probe_success

panels.description: One band per probed URL, once a minute. A gap means the probe itself did not run; red means DNS, TLS, the WAF or the backend failed.

panels.title: Requests by site

targets.expr: sum by (site) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__auto]))

panels.description: Access-log lines per interval per server name. The ntfy site is the phone polling, and everything else is Nextcloud. The legend column is the total over the selected range.

panels.title: Responses by class

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | label_format class="{{ .status | substr 0 1 }}xx" [$__auto]))

panels.description: 2xx ok, 3xx redirects (HTTP to HTTPS, login), 4xx client errors and WAF denials, 5xx backend errors. Counted per interval, so the bar height is what happened in that bar.

panels.title: Why requests were refused

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |= "denied access" | regexp `denied access from (?P<reason>[a-z]+)` | regexp `client: (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` [$__auto]))
label_replace(sum(count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |= "is banned for" | regexp `IP (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+) is banned for` [$__auto])), "series", "new bans", "", "")

panels.description: Every refusal by the check that made it: country (the geo allowlist), dnsbl (a public blocklist), blacklist (BunkerWeb's own), modsecurity (a CRS rule), ban (the client was already blocked). A burst from one address ends in a ban.

panels.title: Probe duration

targets.expr: probe_duration_seconds

panels.description: Full request time of the blackbox probe including DNS and TLS handshake, once a minute. A step up means the backend or the WAF got slower.

panels.title: Response time

targets.expr: label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | status != "101" | rt != "-" | unwrap rt | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (), "series", "total p50", "", "")

label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | status != "101" | rt != "-" | unwrap rt | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (), "series", "total p95", "", "")

label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.5, {service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | status != "101" | urt != "-" | unwrap urt | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (), "series", "upstream p50", "", "")

label_replace(quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | status != "101" | urt != "-" | unwrap urt | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (), "series", "upstream p95", "", "")

panels.description: Total is the time BunkerWeb spends on a request, upstream the part Nextcloud or ntfy takes. The gap is the WAF and TLS. Websockets (status 101) stay open for hours and are left out.

panels.title: 5xx share by site

targets.expr: (sum by (site) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | status =~ "5.." [$__auto])) or sum by (site) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__auto])) * 0) / sum by (site) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__auto]))

panels.description: Share of answers with a 5xx status. Proxy5xx alerts above 5 % over 10 minutes with at least 50 requests.

panels.title: Top clients

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__range])))

panels.description: Addresses with the most requests in the dashboard range. Own devices sit on top; a stranger with thousands of hits is a scanner.

panels.title: Top paths

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (uri) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__range])))

panels.description: Most requested paths across both sites.

panels.title: Top user agents

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (ua) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__range])))

panels.description: mirall is the Nextcloud desktop client; DAVx5 and Thunderbird sync calendars and contacts.

panels.title: ModSecurity rules hit

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (id) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |= "ModSecurity" | regexp `\[id "(?P<id>\d+)"\]` | id != "" [$__range])))

panels.description: OWASP CRS rule ids over the dashboard range. 930130 is scanners probing /.env and friends; 920440 a blocked file extension; 949110 the anomaly-score block itself.

panels.title: Responses by status

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__range]))

panels.description: Exact status codes over the dashboard range.

panels.title: Banned clients

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (ip) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |= "is banned for" | regexp `IP (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+) is banned for` [$__range])))

panels.description: Addresses BunkerWeb banned in the dashboard range, and how often. A ban lasts 24 h; `bwcli unban <ip>` in the scheduler container lifts one early.

panels.title: Refused clients

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (ip, reason) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |= "denied access" | regexp `denied access from (?P<reason>[a-z]+)` | regexp `client: (?P<ip>[0-9a-fA-F.:]+)` [$__range])))

panels.description: Addresses that were refused, with the check that refused them.

panels.title: Requests by site and method

targets.expr: sum by (site, method) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__range]))

panels.description: PROPFIND and REPORT are WebDAV/CalDAV clients syncing.

panels.title: Top clients by status

targets.expr: topk(30, sum by (status, ip) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" [$__range])))

panels.description: Each address with the status codes it received, over the dashboard range, biggest pair first. Click the status column to sort by code and read who caused the 403s or the 404s. Own devices fill the 2xx rows. The 30 largest pairs only: LogQL has no top-k per group, and Loki refuses a query above 500 series.

panels.title: Top refused paths

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (uri, status) (count_over_time({service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ `^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+ [0-9a-fA-F.:]+ - ` != "bwapi" | pattern `<site> <ip> - <_> - [<_>] "<method> <uri> <_>" <status> <bytes> "<_>" "<ua>" <rt> <urt>` | status =~ "[0-9]+" | status =~ "403|429|444" [$__range])))

panels.description: Paths answered 403, 429 or 444: what scanners and blocked clients ask for.

panels.title: Bans and denials

targets.expr: {service="bunker", container="bunker-nginx"} |~ "denied access|is banned for"

panels.description: Every refused request and every ban, newest first. If your own address appears, `bwcli unban <ip>` in the bunker-scheduler container lifts it.

panels.title: Errors and certificate events

targets.expr: {service="bunker", container=~"bunker-.*"} |~ "\\[(error|crit|alert|emerg)\\]|\\[ERROR\\]|(?i)certbot|certificate" != "denied access" != "ModSecurity"

panels.description: Error, critical and certificate lines from both containers. Error lines raise BunkerWebError. CertificateExpiresSoon watches the served certificate itself.
